bug_semantics: CredentialsPermissionChecker builds the set of credential IDs to authorize by filtering node.credentials against credential-type names inferred statically from unresolved node parameters. For an HTTP Request node, an attacker with edit access to a shared workflow can put another user's known credential ID under its real credential type while setting genericAuthType to an expression. The pre-execution checker sees the expression source string rather than the runtime-resolved type, so the real credential key is omitted from the authorization query; execution later resolves the expression and loads/uses that credential, enabling unauthorized use or exfiltration.
flaw_origin: The smallest causal change is PR member commit 7d6023fe3478df86d88f3602f1ea5b53819a050b. It changed mapCredIdsToNodes from checking every referenced credential to skipping any credential whose key is not in getActiveCredentialTypes, and its new static inference handled nodeCredentialType but not dynamically selected generic credential types. Squash landing 608e3bf214328e679c03da3e4a6e9c22ceaac9ca carried that flaw. Later bundle 2d9a2ec76e180b54e8091e31b1e0638c909abd99 added genericAuthType to the static set, fixing literal generic types but preserving the advisory's expression form because it inserted the unresolved expression literal rather than the resolved credential type.
ai_marker: absent: BIC commit object 7d6023fe3478df86d88f3602f1ea5b53819a050b has human author and committer Guillaume Jacquart <jacquart.guillaume@gmail.com>; its complete message is 'refine credential access check to discard not actively used credentials' and contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Made-with, bot, or other AI marker.
evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-6qc9-mqvw-jg7x states the authenticated shared-workflow attack, unresolved genericAuthType comparison, runtime credential load, and patched boundaries 1.123.67, 2.31.5, and 2.32.1. In the validated clone, git log -S 'activeCredTypes' identified squash landing 608e3bf214328e679c03da3e4a6e9c22ceaac9ca; git log -L over mapCredIdsToNodes showed that landing first added activeCredTypes plus `if (activeCredTypes !== null && !activeCredTypes.has(credType)) continue`. GitHub's PR #25599 commit list decomposes that squash into 7d6023fe3478df86d88f3602f1ea5b53819a050b and test-only cleanup ad77114af1f8f801fb725f8d1010744baaa4b74a; https://api.github.com/repos/n8n-io/n8n/commits/7d6023fe3478df86d88f3602f1ea5b53819a050b shows the vulnerable production hunk, parent 0970e4f32cb7efbe257f0ea8105233c3b3a4e179, human identities, and the complete trailer-free message. Direct parent-tree verification via https://raw.githubusercontent.com/n8n-io/n8n/0970e4f32cb7efbe257f0ea8105233c3b3a4e179/packages/cli/src/executions/pre-execution-checks/credentials-permission-checker.ts shows mapCredIdsToNodes iterating Object.values(node.credentials) and authorizing every ID; NodeTypes, getActiveCredentialTypes, activeCredTypes, and the skip condition are absent. `git tag --contains 608e3bf214328e679c03da3e4a6e9c22ceaac9ca --list 'n8n@2.*'` begins at n8n@2.9.0 and returns no n8n@2.8.* tags, matching PR #25599's release comment. `git show 2d9a2ec76e180b54e8091e31b1e0638c909abd99` shows the later unresolved `activeTypes.add(genericAuthType)` change, while `git show 2222fe3a6c886a9059f28e1b6d4bdb10ee420624` and backport f69dfc6dd2178a14ea1624d2e1d403c2e755042f show the fix importing isExpression and returning null for expression-valued nodeCredentialType/genericAuthType, which makes mapCredIdsToNodes check all referenced credentials. Tag containment places f6cb6cf3ab177c3740a5ef624b89bae5165405a1 in n8n@2.31.5, f69dfc6dd2178a14ea1624d2e1d403c2e755042f in n8n@2.32.1, 1cd2c5fb22a906058cc083c3af2d561ce7f4332d in n8n@1.123.67, and direct mainline fix 2222fe3a6c886a9059f28e1b6d4bdb10ee420624 in n8n@2.33.0; the immediately preceding patch tags are not in those containment results.
reasoning: The advisory-described expression bypass is a surviving form of a broader omission introduced before the bundled candidate supplied in the starting context. Before 7d6023fe3478df86d88f3602f1ea5b53819a050b, every credential ID stored on an enabled node was checked, so the target credential could not disappear from the ownership query. That PR member introduced static active-type filtering and the decisive skip. Generic HTTP credentials were not represented by its initial inference; 2d9a2ec76e180b54e8091e31b1e0638c909abd99 later recognized only literal genericAuthType values, leaving expressions mismatched exactly as the advisory describes. Therefore 2d9a2ec76e180b54e8091e31b1e0638c909abd99 is an incomplete mitigation, not the BIC. PR #25599's two public member commit objects make the squash reconstructable: 7d6023fe3478df86d88f3602f1ea5b53819a050b contains the production mechanism and tests; ad77114af1f8f801fb725f8d1010744baaa4b74a only removes a duplicate test. The immediate parent tree directly lacks all active-type filtering and checks every credential. The landed patch reaches n8n@2.9.0, well before the affected 2.x lines, and the isExpression fail-closed change reaches each stated patched boundary. Finally, AI attribution is judged only from the decomposed BIC commit object: it is human-authored/committed and has no AI trailer or bot identity. AI markers on later bundle 2d9a2ec76e180b54e8091e31b1e0638c909abd99 and on fixing bundles are causally and temporally irrelevant, so the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
